settings.heading: How to use
settings.content: Follow the directions shown on the product label. Keep the gummies as part of a consistent daily routine alongside balanced meals.

settings.heading: What’s inside
settings.content: I Am Well Smart Gummies combines selected nutrients including L-Lysine, DHA, Choline, B vitamins, Vitamin C, Vitamin D and Zinc. Refer to the product label for the complete ingredient and nutrition information.

settings.heading: Good to know
settings.content: This is a food supplement and is intended to complement a balanced diet. It is not a substitute for varied meals or professional medical advice.
